steps.1: Squeeze the front brake once and watch both pads land on the rim.
steps.2: Flip the lever open, then unwind the nut on the other side about three turns.
steps.3: Lift the front of the bike and let the wheel drop straight out of the fork.
steps.4: Slide the skewer out. Each spring points its narrow end toward the hub.
steps.5: Wipe the flat metal band the pads touch, all the way round.
steps.6: Pinch two spokes together at a time and work round the wheel. A loose one gives more.
steps.7: Turn the wheel a full circle and look along the tread for cuts or glass.
steps.8: Slide the skewer back through, lever on the left side, springs narrow end in.
steps.9: Lower the fork onto the axle until it sits at the top of both slots.
steps.10: Snug the nut, then fold the lever flat along the fork, pointing up.
steps.11: Spin the wheel and squeeze the brake. It should run clear of both pads.
